title: Lorenz Strange Attractor
subtitle: Non-Linear Dynamical Systems & Butterfly Chaos Theory
description: Interactive study of Edward Lorenz's foundational non-linear ordinary differential equations. Demonstrates the butterfly effect, dual orbital manifolds, Runge-Kutta numerical integration, and real-time Lyapunov divergence of two starting trajectories perturbed by Δx₀ = 10⁻⁵.
